FILA RITMO SLEEK의 실루엣에 두 개의 벨크로 스트랩과 리본 디테일을 더해 새로운 스타일로 재해석했습니다. 각각 길이 조절이 가능한 두 개의 벨크로 스트랩을 적용하였습니다. 앞코에는 리본 형태의 디테일을 더해 클래식한 스니커즈 실루엣에 은은한 포인트를 더했습니다 힐 부분에는 휠라 리니어로고를 적용하였습니다. 어퍼에는 샌드위치 메쉬 소재를 사용해 가볍고 유연한 소재감을 부여합니다. 두 개의 벨크로 스트랩을 적용해 신고 벗기 편리하며, 각각 길이 조절이 가능해 발등의 높이와 형태에 맞춰 세밀한 피팅이 가능합니다. 컬러 구성은 톤온톤으로 통일하여 세련된 분위기를 강조하며, 과하지 않은 색감으로 고급스러운 무드를 극대화 하였습니다. 오솔라이트 인솔을 사용하여 쿠션감 및 항균, 향취 기능을 제공합니다.

products.description: FILA 러닝 퍼포먼스 FLOAT 라인업의 다이얼 시스템 러닝화입니다. 어퍼에는 립스탑 메쉬 소재를 사용해 특유의 격자 조직감이 돋보이는 스포티한 무드를 부여합니다 앞코와 어퍼 레이어에 노쏘 디테일을 적용해 봉제선을 최소화하고 매끄럽고 깔끔한 실루엣을 완성했습니다. 앞코에 3M 포인트를 더해 빛에 따라 은은하게 반사되는 디테일을 구현했습니다. 어퍼 측면에 다이얼 레이싱 시스템이 적용되어, 손쉽게 핏팅감을 조절할 수 있습니다. products.description: AXILUS의 밸런스 쿠셔닝 세그먼트로 새롭게 업그레이드된 AXILUS PRO 4입니다. 최상급 라인업의 올라운드 테니스화로 다양한 플레이 스타일에 최적화된 성능을 제공합니다. 균형 잡힌 쿠셔닝과 뛰어난 내구성을 바탕으로 안정적인 플레이를 지원합니다. SKYFLOAT 미드솔 폼은 균형감 있는 에너지 리턴과 우수한 충격 흡수력을 제공하며, EVERGRIND 러버 아웃솔은 뛰어난 내마모성과 접지력을 자랑합니다. 또한 CAGE TECH 섕크 구조를 적용해 강력한 지지력과 비틀림 방지 성능을 구현하여 격렬한 움직임에도 흔들림 없는 안정성을 제공합니다. PU 캐스팅 어퍼와 모노삭 구조를 적용해 발을 안정적으로 감싸주고 고정력을 높여 경기 중 흔들림을 최소화했습니다. 발목까지 부드럽게 감싸는 설계로 한층 향상된 착용감과 안정적인 피팅감을 제공합니다.

products.name: 97321-320-M | CLASSIC VN | ALFALFA/SNOW WHITE/EGRET
products.description: K-Swiss was founded in 1966 when two Swiss brothers, Art and Ernie Brunner, moved to California to create a footwear brand focused on tennis. As avid skiers and tennis players, the brothers took inspiration from leather ski boots to create a court shoe that supported the aggressive side-to-side movements of tennis. The result was the K-Swiss Classic, the first all-leather tennis shoe manufactured in Los Angeles, California. Over 50 years later that innovation is still the most recognized and bestselling style in our company and has achieved iconic status in the sneaker industry. The Classic VN is the 4th generation of the original shoe. It maintains the trademark elements featured on the first design: 5 stripes, D-ring lacing system, 3 piece toe construction and herringbone brick outsole tread, yet offers the addition of a heel tab that allows for a hint of color and our modern logos to represent the contemporary and progressive values of today’s brand. The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Born out of innovation, the Classic has evolved into a statement of timeless simple design, an expression of our passion for quality and craftsmanship, and an enduring symbol of our authentic tennis heritage. •Leather Upper •Textile Tongue/Collar •Rubber Outsole •IMEVA Midsole •Ortholite Sock Liner •Lace Closure

products.description: K-Swiss was founded in 1966 when two Swiss brothers, Art and Ernie Brunner, moved to California to create a footwear brand focused on tennis. As avid skiers and tennis players, the brothers took inspiration from leather ski boots to create a court shoe that supported the aggressive side-to-side movements of tennis. The result was the K-Swiss Classic, the first all-leather tennis shoe manufactured in Los Angeles, California. Almost 60 years later that innovation is still the most recognized and bestselling style in our company and has achieved iconic status in the sneaker industry. The Classic VN is the 4th generation of the original shoe. It maintains the trademark elements featured on the first design: 5 stripes, D-ring lacing system, 3 piece toe construction and herringbone brick outsole tread, yet offers the addition of a heel tab that allows for a hint of color and our modern logos to represent t he contemporary and progressive values of today’s brand. The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Born out of innovation, the Classic has evolved into a statement of timeless simple design, an expression of our passion for quality and craftsmanship, and an enduring symbol of our authentic tennis heritage. •Leather Upper •Textile Tongue/Collar •Rubber Outsole •IMEVA Midsole •Ortholite Sock Liner •Lace Closure

products.name: 07321-492-M | CLASSIC VN | PEACOAT/WHITE/GUM
products.description: K-Swiss was founded in 1966 when two Swiss brothers, Art and Ernie Brunner, moved to California to create a footwear brand focused on tennis. As avid skiers and tennis players, the brothers took inspiration from leather ski boots to create a court shoe that supported the aggressive side-to-side movements of tennis. The result was the K-Swiss Classic, the first all-leather tennis shoe manufactured in Los Angeles, California. Almost 60 years later that innovation is still the most recognized and bestselling style in our company and has achieved iconic status in the sneaker industry. The Classic VN is the 4th generation of the original shoe. It maintains the trademark elements featured on the first design: 5 stripes, D-ring lacing system, 3 piece toe construction and herringbone brick outsole tread, yet offers the addition of a heel tab that allows for a hint of color and our modern logos to represent t he contemporary and progressive values of today’s brand. The Up-spec version of the VN modernizes our classic shoe with better materials, increased comfort, and improved sustainability. The upper features more premium full-grain leather. The shoe’s sustainability has improved by way of the addition of recycled PET linings and laces, internal components made using recycled ocean plastics, and more eco-friendly foam materials in the sock liner and internal midsole. Born out of innovation, the Classic has evolved into a statement of timeless simple design, an expression of our passion for quality and craftsmanship, and an enduring symbol of our authentic tennis heritage. •Leather Upper •Textile Tongue/Collar •Rubber Outsole •IMEVA Midsole •Ortholite Sock Liner •Lace Closure
